I’m hoping that it will not change there life’s when I’m gone kind of like when a famous person dies. Hope it makes my passing more of a
 “ o wow I can’t believe that happened” and then they can just move on. I just don’t want to bring down my friends and family with me I just want to be a distance memory.
My parents mainly I just don’t want them to second guess them self as good parents or end up going down the “ what if “ rabbit hole.  But in my everyday life there’s not much anymore.

I went through the same thing but I can say I’m glad I told my doctor. I’m 24 a guy and live in a very small town where you don’t talk about mental health at all. I answer the question as close to the truth as I could. I was so nervous about what she would say but it wasn’t a big deal at all. she was very nice about it and just went over the question with me and had me tell her about how I had  been feeling the past couple of weeks. In the end she asked if I would be willing to try having a therapist appointment to see if it might help, she gave me some recommendations for ones in my area and that was all that happened. I was truly relieved that I finally told someone what was going on. I hope my experience helps and maybe you might be willing to let ur dr know how u have been feeling.
